install_app.title: Install NecuTrack
install_app.ios_instructions: In Safari, tap the Share button, then choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install_app.browser_instructions: Open your browser menu, then choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

recipe.title: Recipes
recipe.description: Combine foods, enter the cooked yield, and get accurate nutrition per 100 g.
recipe.create_description: Ingredient nutrition is added together and divided by the final cooked weight.
recipe.edit_description: Update the ingredients or cooked yield and the nutrition values will be recalculated.
recipe.name: Recipe name
recipe.cooked_weight_help: Weigh the complete cooked recipe before saving.
recipe.ingredients_help: Choose each food and enter the total amount used in grams or millilitres.
recipe.type_to_search: Type at least 2 characters to search
recipe.no_results_description: Try another recipe or ingredient name.
recipe.saved_description: Saved recipes also appear in Foods and can be logged by weight.
recipe.empty_description: Create your first recipe to calculate its nutrition automatically.
recipe.delete_description: “{{recipe}}” will also be removed from your foods. Existing diary entries remain unchanged.
recipe.macro_summary: Protein {{protein}} g · Carbs {{carbs}} g · Fat {{fat}} g · Fibre {{fibre}} g per 100 g
recipe.create_food_help: Choose whether the nutrition values apply to a weight or volume basis. The new food will also be available in your food library.

layout.private_data: A private space for your nutrition data.
layout.promo_quote: Understand your week without turning every meal into a spreadsheet.
layout.promo_copy: Fast food logging, clear macro targets, and reports that tell a useful story.

landing.head_title: A calmer way to track nutrition
landing.headline: See what you eat. Understand your week.
landing.description: Log meals quickly, keep calories and macros in view, and use simple reports to spot patterns that matter.
landing.feature_log_copy: Search, enter an amount, and get back to your day.
landing.feature_targets_copy: Calories and macros are clear without becoming obsessive.
landing.feature_reports_copy: Daily and weekly views help you understand patterns.

auth.login_description: Sign in to continue your food diary and see how your week is shaping up.
auth.register_description: Create a private account, set your targets, and log your first meal in a few minutes.
auth.reset_description: Enter your email and we’ll send you a secure reset link.
auth.choose_password_description: Use a strong password you haven’t used elsewhere.
auth.two_factor_description: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.verify_description: Verify your email address to keep your account secure.
auth.verification_sent: A new verification link has been sent.

onboarding.title: Make the diary yours
onboarding.description: Start with targets you already use. You can change everything later in your profile.
onboarding.hint: Macro and fibre values are optional in foods, but targets help make your weekly reports more useful.

diary.title: Food diary
diary.quick_entry_description: Log the total calories directly. Add macros and fibre if you know them; otherwise they will be saved as zero.
diary.entry_name_help: Leave empty to use “Quick calorie entry”.
diary.optional_macros_help: Enter totals for the complete entry, not values per 100 g.
diary.quantity_help: How many times this amount was consumed.
diary.note_placeholder: Energy, appetite, training, or anything useful…

food.logging_description: Choose a food or recipe, then enter the unit, amount, and quantity.
food.library_description: Your favourites are shown first. Search the full food database as you type.
food.scan_barcode_help: Hold the barcode horizontally inside the frame. Keep it steady and move slightly closer if needed.
food.camera_preview: Live camera preview for barcode scanning
food.camera_permission_error: Camera access was denied. Allow camera access in your browser settings and try again.
food.camera_unavailable: No suitable camera is available on this device.
food.camera_unsupported: Camera scanning is not supported by this browser.
food.camera_error: The camera could not be started. Close other apps using it and try again.
food.no_results_copy: Check the spelling, try fewer words, or add it as a custom food.
food.barcode_not_found_copy: Add its name and nutrition information. The barcode will be saved automatically.
food.add_product_details_copy: Enter the name and nutrition information shown on the package.
food.empty_library_copy: Add a custom food to start building your personal library.
food.empty_favourites_copy: Search for a food and tap the heart to keep it here.
food.macro_summary: Protein {{protein}} g · Carbs {{carbs}} g · Fat {{fat}} g · Fibre {{fibre}} g

reports.title: Weekly report
reports.description: Trends and averages from your food diary.
reports.empty_patterns: Log a few meals to see your patterns.

settings.title: Profile
settings.session_copy: Sign out on this device. Your diary data remains safely stored in your account.
settings.delete_copy: Permanently removes your profile, diary, custom foods, targets, and reports. This cannot be undone.
settings.delete_confirm: Delete your account and all nutrition data permanently?
